title: Gringo ECE Anthracite

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Tailored for custom cruisers and classic roadsters, the Biltwell Gringo ECE Anthracite is crafted for laid-back highway cruising with timeless retro lines. Featuring a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan architecture at 1462g, it combines progressive kinetic energy dissipation across ECE 22.06 certifications with an acoustically tuned ~96 dB aero profile. A plush, washable 3D comfort liner cradles Intermediate Oval head shapes with zero temple pinch for glasses wearers, locked in securely with track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

product_details.description: ECE-only version with thinner shell and lighter weight.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for a wide range of head shapes with an extended fit profile; may feel slightly loose on very small heads.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Biltwell Gringo ECE Anthracite: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: Biltwell Gringo ECE Anthracite: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the Biltwell Gringo ECE Anthracite. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

introduction: Positioned in Biltwell's Full Face lineup, the Gringo ECE Anthracite brings Global Premium engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified ECE 22.06 track safety.
story:
The Biltwell Gringo ECE Anthracite represents Biltwell's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~96 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Full Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Biltwell Gringo ECE Anthracite delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
